scope: isolated symmetric double-passage coherence diagnostic plus literature/source audit; not a coherent five-branch solver

source_evidence.ARSENY_CPC_2023: Eq. (51)-(52) uses stochastic probability matrices; no coherent phases are propagated in the printed Eq. (50) assembly.
source_evidence.Stolterfoht_PRA81_052704_2010: He2+ + H charge-transfer probabilities show Stückelberg oscillations produced by coherent contributions from two localized transition regions.
source_evidence.LZSM_review: Two-passage interference requires phase information; phase-erased population propagation is not a coherent prediction.

full_network_authority_missing: crossing amplitude matrices including Stokes phases
dynamical phase integrals between successive crossings on approach and recession
phase convention and coherent coupling through the rotational block
coherent treatment of absorbing Nmax sink or an explicit decoherence model
authority for random-phase/dephasing assumptions if Markov propagation is retained as a physical approximation

direct_hidden_crossing_authority.citation: R. K. Janev, J. Pop-Jordanov, E. A. Solov'ev, J. Phys. B 30, L353-L360 (1997), DOI 10.1088/0953-4075/30/10/005
direct_hidden_crossing_authority.same_system: He2+ + H and inverse charge exchange
direct_hidden_crossing_authority.topological_phase: gamma=pi/2 for a square-root branch point in the adiabatic v->0 limit
direct_hidden_crossing_authority.impact_parameter_average: at sufficiently small v, chi(b) varies rapidly with b and cos^2 may be replaced by mean 1/2 in total-cross-section integration
direct_hidden_crossing_authority.modified_ARSENY: the 1997 work states that a modified ARSENY evolution matrix incorporated dynamical and topological phases
direct_hidden_crossing_authority.scope_limit: source averaging statement is for adiabatic total cross sections; it is not authority for phase erasure in differential/state-resolved/full multibranch observables at arbitrary velocity
